name: Zuluf Field-Ju'aymah Crude Oil Pipeline(s)

values.RouteType: Not mapped (but could be — route or endpoints are known)
values.RouteNotes: Endpoints only (field CPF to Ju'aymah export terminal); no traced geometry or route km found in open sources. CRPO 79 tender describes two 42-in oil trunklines (east/west) plus a 42-in water-injection line running onshore+offshore from the Zuluf development to a beach valve station -- that spec covers the offshore-field-to-onshore-landfall leg. The separate onshore leg carrying stabilized crude on to Ju'aymah terminal is described in project-database write-ups without its own diameter/length, so the 42-in figure should be read as confirmed for the offshore/beach-valve segment, not verified end-to-end to Ju'aymah.

researcher_notes: RE-CHECK vs existing rows: none of the 50 existing Saudi Arabia GOIT oil rows name Zuluf or Tanajib, and none run field-to-Ju'aymah on this route (the two Juaymah-adjacent rows, P1958 Safaniyah-Juaymah and P1987/1988/1989 Qatif Junction-Juaymah, are different fields/corridors) -- genuinely new, not a rename/duplicate. Add-threshold: (a) sponsor Saudi Aramco confirmed independently by offshore-technology and nsenergybusiness -- Aramco already exists in the oil entity table (entity_lookup exact match, no new entity created); (b) endpoints Zuluf offshore field -> onshore CPF -> Ju'aymah crude terminal, Saudi Arabia, confirmed by nsenergybusiness + offshore-technology; (c) concrete step -- CRPO 79 EPC tender (metenders, Jan 2020: two 42-in oil trunklines east/west + 42-in water-injection line, onshore+offshore, beach valve station) and zawya's June 2024 update that the Zuluf crude-oil-increment project is in active EPC targeting ~2026 completion. All three legs clear -- new_row, Status=construction. Capacity 600,000 bpd is the Zuluf 'AH' crude increment the pipeline(s) are sized to carry (nsenergybusiness), used as the best available capacity proxy since no separate pipeline-only throughput figure was published. One caveat folded into RouteNotes: the CRPO 79 tender's 42-in trunkline spec plainly covers the offshore-field-to-beach-valve-station leg; the further onshore run from the CPF to Ju'aymah terminal is described qualitatively ('new downstream pipelines ... send stabilized crude to Ju'aymah') by nsenergybusiness/offshore-technology without its own diameter or length, so treat 42-in as confirmed for part of the route, not the full length. Also flagging a discovery-note accuracy issue: the queue evidence listed upstreamonline.com/.../2-1-1073114 as corroborating 'CRPO 79' via McDermott, but the fetched article text only discusses CRPOs 73, 74 and 84 (McDermott bidding) -- 'CRPO 79' does not appear in it; Zuluf shows up only via a linked related-story headline. That source was verified live (200 OK, 'Zuluf' present) but is NOT used as a ref here because it doesn't actually support the CRPO 79 claim -- excluded rather than cited. The remaining four sources (nsenergybusiness, offshore-technology, metenders, zawya) are independently published (project-database site, separate project-database site, tender-listing site, regional business-news wire) and mutually corroborate route/scope/status, so independent=true holds without the upstreamonline piece. Tier=medium: sponsor/route/status are solid and cross-corroborated, but no route geometry, no confirmed full-route length, and the diameter figure is segment-specific as noted above -- not solid enough for 'high'.
